FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these is said as sa-LÜ? (1 mark)
   A. au revoir
   B. salut
   C. merci
   D. bonjour

2. How do you say 'It is the baby.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est ma sœur.
   B. Mon père s'appelle David.
   C. Voici ma famille.
   D. C'est le bébé.

3. What does 'la famille' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the girl
   B. the father
   C. the family
   D. the grandfather

4. What does 'la chaise' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the bedroom
   B. the chair
   C. the ball
   D. the bag

5. How do you say 'There is a sofa in the living room.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est une table.
   B. Le livre est sur la table.
   C. Il y a un canapé dans le salon.
   D. Mets le livre dans la chambre.

6. What does 'le salon' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the chair
   B. the table
   C. the living room
   D. the TV

7. Fill in: lundi, mardi, ______, jeudi. (1 mark)
   A. vendredi
   B. mercredi
   C. samedi
   D. dimanche

8. What number is 'dix' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 19
   C. 10
   D. 11

9. What number is 'neuf' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 9
   D. 21

10. What number is 'vingt-cinq' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 17
   C. 25
   D. 10

11. What does 'le thé' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tea
   B. the banana
   C. the cake
   D. rice

12. Fill in: C'est ______ banane. (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. une
   C. un
   D. des

13. How do you say 'I eat a mango.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.
   B. Ce sont des mangues.
   C. C'est bon pour la santé.
   D. Je mange une mangue.

14. What does 'court' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. long
   B. short
   C. black
   D. tall, big

15. What does 'les yeux' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the head
   B. the back
   C. the eyes
   D. the knee

16. How do you say 'He has short hair.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Elle a les cheveux longs.
   B. Il a les cheveux courts.
   C. J'ai deux mains.
   D. Touche ton nez !

17. Fill in: Excusez-moi, où ______ l'école ? (1 mark)
   A. sont
   B. ai
   C. est
   D. fait

18. How do you say 'The cat is behind the door.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?
   B. Il est sur la table.
   C. Le lit est dans la chambre.
   D. Le chat est derrière la porte.

19. Read: Amina: Excusez-moi, où est l'école ? Kamau: Allez tout droit. Tournez à gauche. Amina: Merci ! Kamau: De rien ! Question: Which way should she turn? (1 mark)
   A. back
   B. right
   C. up
   D. left

20. What does 'Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my sister.
   B. This is my father.
   C. My mother is called Grace.
   D. My sister is called Njeri.

21. What does 'C'est le bébé.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is the baby.
   B. This is my brother.
   C. This is my father.
   D. Here is my grandfather.

22. What does 'Ma mère s'appelle Grace.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. My mother is called Grace.
   B. Who is it?
   C. I have a brother and a sister.
   D. This is my father.

23. Fill in: Le sac est ______ la chambre. (in) (1 mark)
   A. sous
   B. derrière
   C. dans
   D. sur

24. Which little word goes with 'chaise' (the chair)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. les
   C. l'
   D. le

25. What does 'Mon anniversaire, c'est le 30 juin.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Happy birthday!
   B. There is a cake and there are balloons.
   C. My birthday is on 30 June.
   D. I sing and I dance.

26. Which little word goes with 'riz' (the rice)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. les
   C. la
   D. l'

27. What does 'Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is good for your health.
   B. It is not good for your health.
   C. I drink a juice.
   D. In the morning, I eat bread.

28. What does 'Le frigo est dans la cuisine.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Where is the key?
   B. The cat is behind the door.
   C. Turn left.
   D. The fridge is in the kitchen.

29. Which little word goes with 'magasin' (the shop)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. la
   C. le
   D. les

30. Fill in: ______ sœur s'appelle Njeri. (1 mark)
   A. Le
   B. Un
   C. Mon
   D. Ma

31. How do you say 'behind' in French? (1 mark)
   A. devant
   B. sur
   C. derrière
   D. sous

32. How do you say the month 'July' in French? (1 mark)
   A. juillet
   B. février
   C. novembre
   D. avril

33. How do you write the number 5 in French? (1 mark)
   A. trois
   B. neuf
   C. dix-huit
   D. cinq

34. How do you write the number 6 in French? (1 mark)
   A. quatre
   B. quinze
   C. six
   D. dix-sept

35. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'tea'? (1 mark)
   A. thé
   B. thè
   C. the
   D. té

36. How do you say 'fish' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le jus
   B. le poisson
   C. les légumes
   D. les frites

37. How do you say 'the carrot' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le pain
   B. la carotte
   C. le poulet
   D. l'orange

38. How do you say 'the eyes' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le doigt
   B. le bras
   C. les yeux
   D. le ventre

39. How do you say 'It is raining.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a du vent.
   B. Il pleut.
   C. Il fait chaud.
   D. Il fait beau.

40. How do you say 'the rug' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le tapis
   B. le jardin
   C. le magasin
   D. la clé

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Translate into English: 'Le lit est dans la chambre.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Translate into English: 'Comment tu t'appelles ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Translate into English: 'C'est bon pour la santé.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into English: 'Voici ma maison.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

45. Translate into French: 'The rug is under the table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Translate into French: 'My birthday is on 30 June.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Translate into French: 'The bag is in the bedroom.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into English: 'Il est sur la table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

49. Write the French words for: yesterday, the school, Friday (3 marks) (3 marks)

50. Translate into English: 'Le lundi, je vais à l'école.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

51. Explain why it is important to store things safely at home. Give two examples. (4 marks) (4 marks)

52. Write the French words for: Put, behind, under (3 marks) (3 marks)

53. Translate into French: 'What day is it today?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

54. Write a five-line greeting card to a friend called Kamau in French. (5 marks) (5 marks)

55. Write three sentences about foods you like and do not like in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

56. Write a short dialogue asking for directions to the school. (4 marks) (4 marks)

57. Translate into French: 'On Monday, I go to school.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

58. Translate into English: 'Je chante et je danse.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

59. Translate into English: 'Ton anniversaire, c'est quand ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — salut
   Salut is said sa-LÜ and the final t is silent.

2. D — C'est le bébé.
   It is the baby. in French is C'est le bébé.

3. C — the family
   la famille means the family.

4. B — the chair
   la chaise means the chair.

5. C — Il y a un canapé dans le salon.
   There is a sofa in the living room. in French is Il y a un canapé dans le salon.

6. C — the living room
   le salon means the living room.

7. B — mercredi
   Wednesday comes between Tuesday and Thursday.

8. C — 10
   dix means 10.

9. C — 9
   neuf means 9.

10. C — 25
   vingt-cinq means 25.

11. A — tea
   le thé means tea.

12. B — une
   Banane is feminine.

13. D — Je mange une mangue.
   I eat a mango. in French is Je mange une mangue.

14. B — short
   court means short.

15. C — the eyes
   les yeux means the eyes.

16. B — Il a les cheveux courts.
   He has short hair. in French is Il a les cheveux courts.

17. C — est
   Où est ... ? asks where something is.

18. D — Le chat est derrière la porte.
   The cat is behind the door. in French is Le chat est derrière la porte.

19. D — left
   Tournez à gauche.

20. D — My sister is called Njeri.
   Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri. means My sister is called Njeri.

21. A — It is the baby.
   C'est le bébé. means It is the baby.

22. A — My mother is called Grace.
   Ma mère s'appelle Grace. means My mother is called Grace.

23. C — dans
   Dans means in.

24. A — la
   chaise is feminine, so we say la chaise.

25. C — My birthday is on 30 June.
   Mon anniversaire, c'est le 30 juin. means My birthday is on 30 June.

26. A — le
   riz is masculine, so we say le riz.

27. B — It is not good for your health.
   Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé. means It is not good for your health.

28. D — The fridge is in the kitchen.
   Le frigo est dans la cuisine. means The fridge is in the kitchen.

29. C — le
   magasin is masculine, so we say le magasin.

30. D — Ma
   Sœur is feminine, so we say ma.

31. C — derrière
   behind in French is derrière.

32. A — juillet
   July in French is juillet.

33. D — cinq
   5 in French is cinq.

34. C — six
   6 in French is six.

35. A — thé
   The correct spelling is thé, with its accents.

36. B — le poisson
   fish in French is le poisson.

37. B — la carotte
   the carrot in French is la carotte.

38. C — les yeux
   the eyes in French is les yeux.

39. B — Il pleut.
   It is raining. in French is Il pleut..

40. A — le tapis
   the rug in French is le tapis.
